"'''The Rustler Roundup / A New Discovery'''" is the second episode of the [[Young Jedi Adventures Season Two|second season]] of the animated series ''[[Star Wars: Young Jedi Adventures]]''. It was released on [[Disney+]] on [[August 14]], [[2024]].<ref name="Announcement" />

==Official description==
''Kai rounds up nerfs. Lys tracks a rare creature.''
